purpose: Portable PDR and scaffold for visualizing Chromatic Harness layers across Claude, Cursor, VS Code, GitHub, n8n, Mermaid, and observability systems.

auto_clean.description: Automated cleanup of stale worktrees, .pyc files, empty dirs, and merged branches. Supports --dry-run mode.

auto_heal.description: Automated self-healing for harness health issues: manifest staleness, missing gitignore entries, and orphaned artifacts.

harness_swot.description: Generates a SWOT analysis report for the Harness V2 based on audit data from structure, test, GitHub, artifacts, and docs audits.
